posts.name: Azqa
posts.cooked:
With admittedly limited plays against him, so far they've always come down to only 5 or 6 cards left in the environment deck, so his potential danger has been on his flip side rather than his damage dealing side.  That seems to fit thematically too - he's not really trying to hurt humans so much as he's trying to wreck the world enough that civilizations backslide and we don't continue on the path that results in the cosmic event that destroyed his people.

Even if you destroy one of his ongoings per round, he's going to flip and take 3 environment cards out of the deck about every other round, so he's got an ~10-11 round limit on the game.  He definitely seems like one that'll scale noticeably based on the number of heroes.
